query: Consider the following context: The ability to endure extreme corrosion in challenging environments is reduced in stainless steel. This can be addressed by appropriate surface modification techniques to redefine the surface with the required properties. In that context, which method can be used for improved corrosion resistance, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Applying a surface coating or modification can improve corrosion resistance in stainless steel.
generation.material_initial_state: Stainless steel with reduced corrosion endurance
generation.mechanism: Altering the surface properties to reduce corrosion susceptibility
generation.boundary: Dependent on the type and quality of surface modification
generation.uncertainty: The effectiveness of the surface modification technique is uncertain without specific details

falsification_experiment.design: Comparative study of stainless steel samples with and without surface modification in a controlled corrosive environment
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the corrosion rate of the modified stainless steel is not significantly lower than the unmodified sample, the hypothesis is falsified
